_doc: PROJECT-scoped Claude Code settings for this repo. Deliberately minimal: user-level settings (permissions mode, statusline, env, plugins) live in ~/.claude/settings.json — see unix/da_my-ai/src/data/claude/settings.base.json — and duplicating them here would silently override per-machine choices for anyone who clones this repo. Put ONLY repo-specific things here. Local, uncommitted overrides belong in .claude/settings.local.json, which this module never manages.

permissions._doc: Left empty on purpose. Pre-approving commands is a per-person trust decision, not a repo-wide one — the /fewer-permission-prompts skill generates an allowlist from your own transcripts if you want one.
